notes: Lead: Mariana Alvarez (Head of Product) — strong need for localized tone + routing. POC scope: agent assist snippets, automated ticket summarization, on-the-fly translation for live agents, tool-calls for CRM ticket updates. Key metrics: maintain agent-saw latency (agent-facing) p95 < 250ms for suggestion generation, ticket summarization < 2s, and end-to-end handoff to Genesys CTI under 500ms. Volume profile: 500 steady agents, expected spikes to 2.5k during marketing campaigns. Language priority: en-US, es-ES, pt-BR, fr-FR, zh-CN. "Tone profiles" required per locale (formal PT-BR for banking customers, neutral FR for EU customers, friendly en-US for SMB). They want fallback chains: high-quality float32 model for primary, quantized low-latency variant for spikes; automatic reroute to Dedicated capacity during region surge. Security: must support SSO/SAML, per-token audit logging, KMS integration for key rotation, and contractual data residency for EU customers. Asked about offline air-gapped option for very sensitive customers — low priority but noted. Integration notes: Genesys and Zendesk connectors are main; existing routing rules use geo-IP + language header. Quote request: lookup for reserved capacity price + hosted overage pricing. "Paraphrases from call": "We need suggestions that are safe to display to agents — no hallucinated actions", "Latency failure = agent churn". Short term asks: provide sample summary output for 200 live tickets; run translation quality benchmark for pt-BR complaints. Long term: embed optimization (reuse cached prefixes), adaptive batching, and per-customer quantization profiles.
requirements_summary: Multilingual agent-assist + ticket summarization with locale-aware tone. P95 suggestion latency target 250ms; summary generation <2s. Support 5 primary locales; ability to scale to 2.5k concurrent agents during spikes. Must integrate with Genesys + Zendesk via tool-calls, support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS, audit logs and EU data residency. Preferred deployment: VPC with option to burst to Redwood Dedicated. Need canary rollouts and regression alerts for quality drops. Legal requires data-flow diagram and SOC2 evidence before procurement.
